headlines.title: Is Honeywell International (HON) Cheap Following Its New AI Alliance Launch?
headlines.summary: Honeywell International stock reacts to new AI alliance news Honeywell International (HON) unveiled Forge Cognition, an AI and simulation platform for managing physical facilities, built with technology from NVIDIA and Dell Technologies. The launch gives investors fresh information on Honeywell’s push into data driven building and industrial operations. Recent trading tells a mixed story. Honeywell International’s share price has slipped 1.12% over the past day and 2.

headlines.title: Should Honeywell’s AI Push and Kenya Megarefinery Win Require Action From Honeywell International (HON) Investors?
headlines.summary: In recent weeks, Honeywell Technologies introduced Forge Cognition, an agentic AI and simulation platform for facility operations developed with NVIDIA and Dell Technologies, while Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE selected Honeywell Technologies for a roughly US$300 million scope of process technologies and digital solutions for a planned 700,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Kenya.

headlines.title: What Is Honeywell (HON) Signaling With Its New AI Facility Platform?
headlines.summary: Honeywell International (NasdaqGS:HON) has launched Forge Cognition, a self-contained AI and simulation platform for large facilities. The new system uses partnerships with NVIDIA and Dell to combine accelerated computing, AI models, and industrial simulation hardware. Forge Cognition applies real-time digital twins and AI agents to support building and industrial site operations across energy, safety, and maintenance.

headlines.title: Honeywell (HON) Stock Looks Cheap After Its 47% YTD Fall
headlines.summary: Honeywell International has seen a sharp year to date share price decline, which naturally puts fresh scrutiny on whether the current valuation can still be explained by the earnings the business generates. With the stock now trading around US$207.29, the key issue is how that price lines up with what its profit stream suggests investors are paying for. The share price is down 47.

headlines.title: Exclusive: Honeywell Technologies launches a ‘brain behind the building’ with Nvidia and Dell. Its CTO says humans will run it for now
headlines.summary: Forge Cognition, tested at Nvidia’s Voyager headquarters, is Honeywell Technologies' first big AI bet since its breakup.

description: Honeywell International Inc. engages in the industrial automation, building automation, and energy and sustainability solutions businesses in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The Industrial Automation segment provides automation control and instrumentation products and services; smart energy products; sensing technologies, including custom-engineered sensors and related services; gas detection technologies and personal protective equipment; and system design automation equipment, as well as software and analytics for manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment operations. The Building Automation segment provides software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and system upgrade services. The Energy and Sustainability Solutions segment, through its UOP business, delivers licensed process technology, equipment, engineering, catalysts, adsorbents, and services for refining, petrochemicals, low-carbon energy, gas and LNG, and industrial solutions, as well as connectivity, data integration, and software solutions. The company was formerly known as AlliedSignal, Inc. Honeywell International Inc. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
